title: Lab remote task list
objective: Integrate RHF/Zod validation, same-origin authenticated-by-nobody teaching POST, Query list/invalidation, conditional status PATCH and explicit error recovery.
predict: A valid task POST updates the list; 422 blocks or shows an error; 412 requires refetch; a failed optimistic deletion must roll back.
expectedBehavior: Using the actual loopback API and installed RHF/Query, prove valid create→GET refresh, invalid title no-POST, 422/error retry, 412 version conflict and a rollback path in the companion task workspace.
commonFailure: The starter submits unvalidated data to the wrong endpoint and never invalidates remote list state.
securityBoundary: The teaching API is in-memory and unauthenticated. Do not deploy this workflow publicly or imply that Zod/client query keys provide access control.
